display.purpose: Primary identity line when the terminal page needs a stronger first fold.

headline.purpose: Inline highlighted section labels and command results.

body.purpose: Readable terminal output, bio copy, list items, and contact text.

label.purpose: Prompt fragments, command text, and terminal state syntax.

motion.name: typewriter
motion.purpose: First prompt shell animation; must be disabled or simplified under reduced motion.

motion.name: output-fade
motion.purpose: Current delayed output reveal; documented as existing behavior, not a recommended content gate.

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: Live prompt cursor flavor; must not distract from reading.

components.name: Shell Page
components.css: .ds-shell-page { background: #24283b; color: #c0caf5; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; min-height: 180px; padding: 16px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-shell-page span { color: #7aa2f7; } .ds-shell-page strong { color: #9ece6a; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Prompt Line
components.description: The core command prompt identity primitive.
components.html: hshekhar@bhayanak ~ $ cat now.md
components.css: .ds-prompt-line { background: #24283b; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; color: #c0caf5; } .ds-prompt-user { color: #bb9af7; } .ds-prompt-path { color: #7aa2f7; } .ds-prompt-dollar { color: #9ece6a; } .ds-prompt-command { color: #c0caf5; }

components.name: Command Label
components.description: Flat inline highlighted label for command output sections.
components.css: .ds-command-label { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; background: #bb9af7; color: #1a1b26; padding: 0 0.5em; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Output Text
components.description: Terminal response copy. Existing muted value is documented but should be contrast-corrected for essential body text.
components.html: Software engineer with a day job in automation. Tinkerer. Always building something.
components.css: .ds-output-text { max-width: 80ch; background: #24283b; color: #565f89; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Text-only contact/action link with terminal arrow syntax.
components.css: .ds-text-link { background: #24283b; color: #7aa2f7; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bb9af7; text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Cursor
components.description: Block cursor for the playful live prompt state.
components.css: .ds-cursor { display: inline-block; width: 0.55em; height: 1em; background: #c0caf5; vertical-align: text-bottom; animation: ds-blink 0.5s step-end infinite alternate; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cursor { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: This design system is a compact shell session for a real engineer, not a generic portfolio dressed in dark mode. The surface is Tokyo Night Storm, the voice is mono-forward, and the rhythm is command then output. It should feel like a competent terminal that occasionally reveals a joke, not a joke that happens to contain a résumé. The system is deliberately flat. Depth comes from terminal roles: prompt identity, path color, command color, output color, cursor behavior, and highlighted command labels. No cards, no soft shadows, no decorative panels.
keyCharacteristics: Mono-forward, single-family typography with JetBrains Mono.
Tokyo Night Storm base with violet, blue, and green prompt roles.
Flat terminal primitives instead of cards, shadows, or glass.
Short command/output groupings with high information density.
Mischief is allowed only when it does not hide content or reduce accessibility.

rules.name: The Role Color Rule
rules.body: Violet identifies the prompt/system label, blue identifies paths and links, green identifies prompt punctuation or success. Do not use these colors interchangeably.

rules.name: The Ghost Is Not Body Rule
rules.body: Muted terminal output may annotate; it must not carry essential body text below WCAG AA contrast.

rules.name: The No Beige Escape Rule
rules.body: Do not soften the site into cream, sand, paper, or warm-neutral portfolio territory. The shell is the brand surface.

rules.name: The One Font Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono carries the whole identity. Add hierarchy through role, color, spacing, and content structure before adding another typeface.

rules.name: The Flat Shell Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are not lifted. If something needs emphasis, make it a command, a prompt state, or a label — not a card.

rules.name: The No Ghost Card Rule
rules.body: Never combine a 1px border with a soft wide drop shadow. That pattern is prohibited for this brand.

dos: Do preserve the Storm Console roles: Prompt Violet for prompt identity, Path Blue for paths/links, Dollar Green for $, Storm Ink for readable commands.
Do keep the layout terminal-native and flat; use prompts and command structure instead of cards.
Do make essential text meet WCAG AA contrast before treating it as production body copy.
Do keep content visible by default; motion may enhance but must not hide the page.
Do make playful details feel earned: one good terminal joke beats constant gimmick motion.
Do use exact, personal copy that sounds like Himanshu rather than portfolio-generator filler.
donts: Don't create a generic SaaS portfolio: no gradient cards, hero-metric templates, startup sameness, or template polish without personality.
Don't create a corporate résumé page: no sterile recruiter-first layout that removes the terminal voice.
Don't create unreadable terminal cosplay: no tiny text, low contrast, hidden links, motion gimmicks, or jokes that block scanning.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, side-stripe card borders, or repeating stripe backgrounds.
Don't add rounded cards, nested cards, or soft shadows to make the page feel designed. That is the wrong register.
Don't use Ghost Output for essential body text unless the contrast is corrected to ≥4.5:1.
